{"description":"Priority: P1 | Area: docs | Labels: docs,area:docs,P1 | Milestone: v0.1.0 | RFC: n/a | Task: CTX-XXXX

Import the plugin-ecosystem corpus from bitty-docs @ c664214 into bitty-plugins-docs with history.
Parent context: bitty-docs CTX-0187 (docs split: bitty-terminal-docs / bitty-ai-docs / bitty-plugins-docs; plugin phase).

Source (bitty-docs@c664214, docs/projects/bitty/) -> target (repository root):

- specifications/plugin-platform-rfc.md
- specifications/plugin-host-runtime-rfc.md
- specifications/plugin-api-v1-lua-surface-rfc.md
- specifications/plugin-reuse-and-providers.md
- specifications/lua-runtime-rfc.md
- specifications/isolation-resource-rfc.md
- specifications/package-lifecycle-rfc.md
- specifications/package-followup-rfc.md
- specifications/ui-extensibility-architecture.md
- product/plugin-roadmap.md
- extensibility/plugin-system.md
- extensibility/package-management.md

Method: git 2.55 git-subtree accepts a single --prefix (last -P wins; verified empirically), so multi-path
subtree split is impractical. Fallback extraction: git filter-repo (path-limited rewrite, prefix-renamed
docs/projects/bitty/ -> root) in a scratch bitty-docs clone at c664214, then merge --allow-unrelated-histories
into the task branch; normal PR, no force-push.

Link policy: relative links inside the migrated set stay relative; links into terminal-platform content become
https://github.com/bitty-terminal/bitty-terminal-docs/blob/main/<path>; shared governance becomes
https://github.com/bitty-terminal/bitty-docs/blob/main/docs/<path>; AI-core links (none found) would use
bitty-ai-docs.

Bookkeeping updates: repo README.md, docs/README.md, docs/development/documentation-workflow.md, AGENTS.md,
TODO.md, CHANGELOG.md so no page still claims "no content migrated" after this lands.

Out of scope: status-system.md (terminal-owned status bar spec; keeps plugin/provider extension points but
stays with terminal docs), architecture diagrams, ADRs (shared governance).

Gates: just fmt, just check, git diff --check, act -n -W .github/workflows/ci.yml. Evidence and head SHA
recorded in the PR; stop at open PR (no merge).","displayId":"CTX-0001","id":"01M2DY5ZFG2DNM7T8BC85238MA","priority":"high","status":"ready","title":"docs(import): migrate plugin-ecosystem content from bitty-docs"}
